sources.title: Introducing the SWE-Lancer benchmark
sources.used_for: 2025年2月发布；真实历史支付合计100万美元；IC端到端评分、Manager对照历史选择；7月17日数据变更并在28日加注。
sources.limitations: an updated dataset removes execution-time Internet dependency; not a controlled estimate of production productivity

sources.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
sources.used_for: 731公共题，286初筛；复核200与249分别为27.4%与34.1%；五人审阅；四类缺陷及OpenLibrary前导空格例子；撤回早先Pro推荐。
sources.limitations: OpenAI audit of flagged public tasks; not a random sample or audit of private splits; no task re-execution here

sources.title: Introducing SWE-bench Verified
sources.used_for: 原始12个Python仓库，500人工筛选题，Docker环境；两类测试均通过方算解决；静态公开集及scaffold影响。
sources.limitations: 12 repositories describes source pool; human screening is not a perpetual quality or contamination guarantee

sources.title: SWE-Bench Pro: Raising the Bar for Agentic Coding
sources.used_for: 1865题、41仓库，731公开/858保留/276商业；任务及语言仓库差异；GPL抗污染是设计主张；作者也强调内部仓库效用。
sources.limitations: promotional claims of realism and contamination resistance need separate verification; original release figures

sources.title: SWE-Lancer: Can Frontier LLMs Earn $1 Million from Real-World Freelance Software Engineering?
sources.used_for: Expensify的Upwork任务；1488=764 IC+724 Manager；Diamond502=237+265，500800美元；IC Playwright E2E；Manager历史选择；Docker和pass@1；奖金按通过题的历史支付相加。
sources.limitations: one product/repository; manager choice is not implementation; original v1 denominators differ from offline release

sources.title: SWE-Lancer — preparedness repository README
sources.used_for: 公开237 IC题调整为198离线题、39移除；容器；当前仅离线rollout视为有效；Manager有独立运行配置。
sources.limitations: mutable main snapshot; 198 is IC subset and not all original Diamond tasks

sources.title: Why SWE-bench Verified no longer measures frontier coding capabilities
sources.used_for: 138反复失败题的59.4%有材料问题；披露若干模型复现补丁/题文污染迹象；当时推荐Pro，需与7月撤回连读。
sources.limitations: targeted failure subset; 59.4% is not defect rate of all 500 tasks

sources.title: SWE-Bench Pro: Can AI Agents Solve Long-Horizon Software Engineering Tasks?
sources.used_for: 容器语言环境；描述、requirements及接口；fail2pass/pass2pass；SWE-Agent原版最多200轮；Pass@1；作者承认测试可能排除有效替代解。
sources.limitations: paper/blog score discrepancies are not used for ranking; PDF relevant text parsed, no chart extraction used

sources.title: SWE-Bench Pro V2
sources.used_for: 642题，删89；69矛盾题文案修复并盲做验证；agent仅模型端点，净镜像重评；参考/空补丁门禁；残余端点及补丁执行信任问题。
sources.limitations: publisher reports own repair and gate outcomes; page retains legacy 731-task description below V2 header

sources.title: SWE-bench Pro V2 — repository README
sources.used_for: V2默认642、hard51、v1配置分开；每题50分钟、离线agent阶段、干净容器重评；HARD51按五模型家族失败筛选；529题重写、214测试补丁和38gold patch修改。
sources.limitations: 529 rewritten prompts and website 69 contradictory prompts have different scopes; controls not a proof against all gaming

sources.title: SWE-bench Pro V2 release gate
sources.used_for: 642/642 controls with three first-pass infrastructure failures in each arm; reruns complete; timing-sensitive test caveat.
sources.limitations: Publisher execution record, not independent reproduction; no measured model productivity.

claims.claim: Verified是从原始SWE-bench任务池人工筛选的500题；原任务池来自12个Python仓库
claims.uncertainty: 不能表述为500题均覆盖12个仓库或一切工程工作
测试内正确性不等于无任何生产回归

claims.claim: Pro原版1865题、41仓库；731公共、858保留、276商业
Pro包含多语言、多文件功能及修复；容器执行、增强需求及接口、测试判定；原版SWE-Agent pass@1
Pro的GPL设计降低污染风险是发布者主张，不是训练数据排除证明
claims.uncertainty: 没有获得训练数据审计

claims.claim: Lancer原版1488题来自Expensify Upwork；764 IC与724 Manager，历史总支付100万美元
claims.uncertainty: 不是市场中所有自由职业工程任务的随机样本

claims.claim: Lancer IC使用Playwright端到端测试，Manager匹配历史经理选择；分别测实现及提案选择
claims.uncertainty: 匹配经理选择不能证明模型实施了代码

claims.claim: Lancer初版Diamond502题500800美元；公开IC237改198离线题；官方只接受断网运行，当前断网实现依赖Linux。
claims.uncertainty: 198、502、1488分母不同；联网试跑不是有效离线成绩。

claims.claim: 解题率等权，奖金指标按历史支付加权；不能推导本企业节省工时或利润
claims.uncertainty: 缺少成本、人工接管、维护和任务分布

claims.claim: 2026-02 Verified审查59.4%的分母为138道反复失败题；发现若干训练污染迹象
claims.uncertainty: 不是全500题59.4%损坏，污染检测不能量化每个分数中的记忆贡献

claims.claim: 2026-07-08 Pro公共731题初筛286，两路复核得到200及249损坏题
claims.uncertainty: 27.4%和34.1%不相加，不是随机样本区间，不外推商业集

claims.claim: 四类题目/测试缺陷会双向误判；OpenLibrary-77c16d5题文与隐藏测试前导空格一与二不一致，说明遵循题文仍可能被判失败。
Pro V2公共642题/11仓库；官网69道矛盾题修正，仓库529题文重写、214测试补丁、38参考补丁修改，各数字对象不同。
claims.uncertainty: 不推断修改集合互斥或已逐项回应249道旧审查问题；V1/V2成绩不可直接比较。

claims.claim: V2参考/空补丁最终642题全部符合预期，但两组首轮各3次基础设施失败；Agent仅模型端点，setup/verifier仍可联网，全新镜像重评为报告成绩。
claims.uncertainty: 发布者记录；不等于首轮零失败、无任何攻击方式或本次独立复现。

claims.claim: 使用同版本题集、镜像、预算和评分协议先验证环境，V1/V2管线及Lancer断网条件不可混用；公开分只用于候选诊断，生产收益需内部任务观察。
claims.uncertainty: 筛选不等于品牌排序或提效承诺

claims.claim: 建议研发负责人先封存代表性内部任务，由维护者盲验收，对照人工流程统计净收益和回归
claims.uncertainty: 为建议方案，时间与样本量为起点，需按实际波动扩样

requirements.summary: 实际打开并阅读四个起始原始来源的研究相关正文
requirements.evidence: sources/S1.md–S4.md retain actual relevant-section reading observations and original web text with locators

requirements.summary: 比较三项评测研究对象、任务、环境、评分、版本并解释不可换算
requirements.evidence: final.md comparison and V2 paragraphs explicitly distinguish changed datasets, instructions, execution phases and non-comparable scores; S9/S10 support the added explanation.

requirements.summary: 结合2026年7月质疑，区分样本分母和证据边界；不杜撰对方回应；缺陷落实到题目评分修复
requirements.evidence: final.md July audit and OpenLibrary paragraphs distinguish denominators, incorrect rejection and missed defects; source-recheck.md S2/S9/S10 locates the evidence.

requirements.summary: 明确可用筛选信号及生产提效外推限制，提出可执行选择与内部仓库试点，不推荐未测品牌
requirements.evidence: final.md procurement steps add same-version environment checks and offline prerequisites while retaining trial denominators, costs, regressions and no untested brand ranking.

requirements.summary: 全文Markdown计2500–4000非空白字符，含语法和链接；就地引用且无资料清单
requirements.evidence: final.md 3839 nonwhitespace Unicode characters, entire Markdown including markup and links; original 2500–4000 bounds unchanged.

requirements.summary: 完整首稿与原任务保留，保存本次完整修订稿、来源、主张及修订记录；当前Full评审和交付由对应工作流状态核对。
requirements.evidence: first-draft.md and all original source files are retained; drafts/update-first.md and final.md are full text; source-recheck.md and revision-notes-update.md record actual changes. This row attests artifact preservation, not review/delivery success; those are checked separately by the existing workflow.

requirements.summary: 实际核对来源后更新已有长报告，保留原稿、记录具体修改和复用，交付当前完整稿。
requirements.evidence: final.md adds source-confirmed details from S2/S6/S9/S10/S11; source-recheck.md and revision-notes-update.md locate changes and reused material. Current output quality is reviewed separately.
